info.title: OPC UA Model Compiler
info.description: Command-line tool that compiles OPC UA ModelDesign and NodeSet2 XML files into NodeSets, XSD/BSD schemas, and source code (C#, ANSI C, TypeScript, JSON Schema, OpenAPI) for use with the OPC UA .NETStandard stack. Install with: dotnet tool install --global OPCFoundation.Opc.Ua.ModelCompiler.Tool. Invoke as Opc.Ua.ModelCompiler.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: An application takes an OPC UA model file and generates code for the .NETStandard stack.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Takes an OPC UA ModelDesign file and generates a NodeSet and code for the .NETStandard stack.

options.name: -d2
options.description: The path to the ModelDesign or NodeSet2 file which contains the UA information model. The first file specified is the model to generate. The rest are included models. The file path may be followed by the namespace prefix and a short name for model. Commas seperate each field.

options.name: -c
options.description: The path to the CSV file which contains the unique identifiers for the types defined in the UA information model. Not used if the target is a NodeSet2 file.

options.name: -cg
options.description: Creates the identifier file if it does not exist (used instead of the -c option).

options.name: -o2
options.description: The output directory for the generated files.

options.name: -ansic
options.description: The path to use when generating ANSI C stack code (internal use only).

options.name: -stack
options.description: The path to use when generating .NET stack code (internal use only).

options.name: -version
options.description: Selects the source for the input files. v103 | v104 | v105 are supported.

options.name: -useAllowSubtypes
options.description: When subtypes are allowed for a field, C# code with the class name from the model is created instead of ExtensionObject. No effect when subtypes are not allowed. [default: False]

options.name: -id
options.description: The first identifier to use when assigning new ids to nodes.

options.name: -exclude
options.description: Comma seperated list of ReleaseStatus values to exclude from output.

options.name: -mv
options.description: The version of the model to produce.

options.name: -pd
options.description: The publication date of the model to produce.

options.name: -rc
options.description: Indicates that a release candidate nodeset is being generated. [default: False]

options.name: -prefix
options.description: The prefix to use on the generated files names.

options.name: -suppress
options.description: A comma separated list of output types to suppress (PredefinedNodes,Constants,NodeSet,JsonSchema,Classes,DataTypes).

commands.name: units
commands.description: Generates the OPC UA Engineering Units CSV from the official UNECE table of units.

options.name: -annex1
options.description: The path to the UNECE Annex 1 CSV file.

options.name: -annex2
options.description: The path to the UNECE Annex 2/3 CSV file.

options.name: -output
options.description: The output directory.

commands.name: update-headers
commands.description: Updates all files in the output directory with the OPC Foundation MIT license header.

options.name: -input
options.description: The path folders to search for files to update.

options.name: -pattern
options.description: The file pattern to use when selecting files.

options.name: -license
options.description: The type of license (MIT | MITXML | NONE).

options.name: -silent
options.description: Supresses any exceptions. [default: False]

commands.name: compile-nodesets
commands.description: Searches a directory tree for nodesets and generates code for the specified model URIs.

options.name: -input
options.description: The path to the directory containing the nodesets.

options.name: -o2
options.description: The path to the directory to use to write the generated files.

options.name: -prefix
options.description: The prefix on generated files.

options.name: -uri
options.description: The URI of the model to generate.

options.name: -suppress
options.description: A comma separated list of output types to suppress (PredefinedNodes,Constants,NodeSet,JsonSchema,Classes,DataTypes).
